headline: Athens Stock Exchange: Recovering 2,650 Points for the General Index Is Necessary
summary: The Athens Stock Exchange General Index fell 0.35% in the last session of the previous week, closing at 2,559.18 points. The index is down 2.93% for the week and up 20.68% year to date.
why: The Athens General Index tracks the main listed companies on the Greek stock exchange, giving a broad gauge of Greek equity market performance.
